keyEvents.text: Goal! Crewe Alexandra 1, AFC Wimbledon 0. Charlie McNeill (Crewe Alexandra) right footed shot from more than 35 yards to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Conor Thomas.
Jordan Gibson (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
